Chapter 831: Chapter 27: As if Falling into an Ice Cellar (Please Subscribe)_3

Child of the Void has been trapped at the Perfect Ninth Stage for tens of billions, hundreds of billions of years, never able to take that step. Yet shortly after Lin Yuan’s arrival, he broke through.

Lin Yuan speculated that the Child of the Void’s breakthrough might have something to do with him. Many bottlenecks and shackles required a change of heart to overcome.

Nalan, the deputy tower master of the Main Universe’s human civilization, was able to break through to the Eleventh Stage because he lost to Yuan, who was still at the Ninth Stage, in their most proficient competition of the Rule of Time.

“Interesting.”

Lin Yuan stood up, took a step forward, and disappeared from where he was.

…

...

Deep within the Void Secret Realm.

The aura of the Child of the Void was terrifying, with spatial-temporal fluctuations sweeping in all directions. All the Demonic Divine Masters who had reached the Ninth Stage of the Boundless Void sensed it.

“Tenth Stage!”

“I have finally stepped into the Tenth Stage.”

Tears filled the eyes of the Child of the Void as he had been at the Perfect Ninth Stage for far too long. If not for the existence of the Void Secret Realm, he would have doubted whether the Boundless Void had ever given birth to a Tenth Stage Evil God.

“Now… I am also standing at the pinnacle peak throughout the history of the Boundless Void.”

The Child of the Void exuded spatial-temporal aura wantonly, with ambition surging in his eyes, “That Martial Ancestor, I need not be too wary of him anymore.”

Stepping into the Tenth Stage, the Child of the Void’s self-confidence was greatly enhanced. In his view, even if the Martial Ancestor was also a Tenth Stage Evil God, and even stronger than any other Tenth Stage Evil God he knew of, according to the message left by the creator of the secret realm, ordinary Tenth Stage Evil Gods were not capable of treating the Void Secret Realm as nothing.

But no matter what, he was now on the same level as the Martial Ancestor.

The Child of the Void had no intention of fighting against the Martial Ancestor. Rarely did Ninth Stage Evil Gods kill one another, let alone at the Tenth Stage?

Strong beings are not fools. Why would they risk their lives against beings of the same level after cultivating to such a realm?

However, in terms of status, the Child of the Void felt that he should still strive for it.

At the very least, he believed he did not need to grovel as he had before.

At the same time.

The spatial-temporal fluctuations caused by the Child of the Void’s ascension to the Tenth Stage also alarmed the many Perfect Demon True Lords.

“Spatial-temporal fluctuations? Has another powerhouse stepped into the Tenth Stage?”

“Is it the great Child of the Void?”

“Has the Child of the Void broken through to the Tenth Stage?”

…

One after another, the Perfect Demon True Lords were initially incredulous, but then they became invigorated.

Indeed, these years, under the oppression of the Martial Ancestor, they had been living quite stiflingly.

The Martial Ancestor was too strong and influential. Not a single Perfect Demon True Lord dared to defy him, not even dare to speak ill of him in secret.

But now, the Child of the Void has also stepped into the Tenth Stage.

Unlike the Martial Ancestor, at least the Child of the Void was the leader of all Demonic Divine Masters. Before the Martial Ancestor stepped into the Tenth Stage, many Perfect Demon True Lords were following the orders of the Child of the Void.

Compared to the Martial Ancestor, whose temperament was unknown, naturally, many Perfect Demon True Lords preferred the Child of the Void to step into the Tenth Stage.

“Let’s go.”

“Let us go congratulate the Child of the Void now.”

“The great Child of the Void is destined to remain great forever.”

All the Perfect Demon True Lords immediately set off toward the Child of the Void’s location.

…

A spacious grand hall.

The Child of the Void sat high upon the throne, with the Perfect Demon True Lords standing below.

“Great Child of the Void, your ascension to the Tenth Stage means your brilliance will surely envelop the Boundless Void; all life submits under your light…”

One after another, the Perfect Demon True Lords congratulated the Child of the Void with utmost reverence.

The Child of the Void sat quietly on the throne. He had heard such praises countless times before, but now that he had stepped into the Tenth Stage, it felt different.

“Great Child of the Void, from today on, we Evil Gods no longer need to cater to the whims of that Martial Ancestor.”

“That’s right. These few hundred years, I’ve really been living in trepidation, for fear of offending the Martial Ancestor one day.”

“Now it’s fine, with the great Child of the Void here, the Martial Ancestor won’t dare to go too far.”

…

Many Perfect Demon True Lords quickly mentioned the Martial Ancestor, which was inevitable. Before the Child of the Void’s breakthrough to the Tenth Stage, the Martial Ancestor had been the dominator of the Boundless Void.

Even the Child of the Void had to look up to him.

But now, everything was different.

At least, the Boundless Void had two more dominators.

Of course.

The many Perfect Demon True Lords present did not really expect the Child of the Void to strain relations with the Martial Ancestor for their sake.

That’s unrealistic.

But at least he could serve as their solid backing.

Causing the Martial Ancestor to be apprehensive and elevate the status of the Perfect Demon True Lords.

“Rest assured…” The Child of the Void replied, a confident expression on his face, “Now that I have stepped into the Tenth Stage, I will surely not let you suffer any grievances…”

The Child of the Void had not yet finished speaking.

The spatial-temporal surroundings fell into an eerily silent stillness.

This silence, thorough and complete, made even an Evil God of the Tenth Stage like the Child of the Void unable to sense any spatial-temporal fluctuation, as if he had been brought back to the Ninth Stage, no, the feeblest First Stage.

Swoosh.

A figure appeared silently. He looked exceedingly ordinary, without any aura emanating, but in this completely silent spatial-temporal environment, he seemed out of place, as though all of time and space were under his feet.

This figure was Lin Yuan.

Merely appearing, he silenced the entirety of time and space. The aura of the Child of the Void, which was like a boundless ocean, now seemed like a toothless tiger, struggling to even sit on his throne, beads of cold sweat forming.

“Martial… Martial Ancestor…”

The Child of the Void looked up at the Martial Ancestor standing high above. At this moment, how could he not realize that the changes around were all because of the Martial Ancestor, and that he had thought after stepping into the Tenth Stage, he would be able to stand shoulder to shoulder with him?

But now it seemed, it was just a joke.

Without even making a move, the Martial Ancestor was already almost too much for him to bear. Was this what it meant to be on an equal footing?

“I’ve seen that you’ve stepped into the Tenth Stage…” Lin Yuan glanced down at the Child of the Void and said in a calm tone: “So I’ve come over, planning to congratulate you.”

“Thank you, Martial Ancestor…”

“Martial Ancestor, you have troubled yourself.”

The Child of the Void forced a smile, speaking in an utterly respectful manner.

The many Perfect Demon True Lords below were also aware of the completely silent spatial-temporal reality.

However, compared to the change in space and time, the dialogue and postures between the Child of the Void and the Martial Ancestor at this moment made all the Perfect Demon True Lords tremble with fear.

As if plunged into an icehouse.
